designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Atchafalaya National Wildlife Refuge by buying land from the Iberville Land Company, as Congress had directed in 1984.

authority.citation: Public Law 98-548 (Oct. 26, 1984) authorized the refuge; established on purchase of land from the Iberville Land Company

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Atchafalaya National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, 508 Atchafalaya National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 168171): "On October 26, 1984, Congress authorized the establishment of Atchafalaya NWR (Public Law 98-548)"; "Atchafalaya NWR was established in 1986, when 15,255 acres were purchased from the Iberville Land Company"

review.note: CCP: authorized by P.L. 98-548 (Oct. 26, 1984); established 1986 by purchase. Draft 1984 is the authorization year.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Atchafalaya National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1984, is located in the floodplain of the Atchafalaya River, a tributary of the Mississippi that flows into the Gulf of Mexico.
